text: {"lessons":["These swings are uncomfortable, but random past price changes are not a reliable guide to the next month, so I should not chase or flee based on recent performance.","I should check that my holdings and cash leave me with a level of risk I can tolerate, especially given how strongly losses affect me; any changes should follow a plan, not a reaction to a bad month.","Since I rarely trade and there is no new information here, I can review my portfolio periodically against my goals rather than making frequent trades or assuming that inaction is always right."]}
